adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#5
adds.text: Years before, Matt and Foggy get Foggy's childhood neighbor Ray McCoy freed, and Foggy gives McCoy the savings meant for their own firm. Matt shrugs it off, and they head to Josie's still planning their practice.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Best friend since law school, who forgives Foggy for giving away their savings.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Best friend since law school, who gives their firm savings to a client.
adds.evidence: The Grand Design (S2#5) opens with flashbacks of Matt and Foggy as interns at Landman and Zack defending Lionel 'Ray' McCoy; Foggy gives McCoy the money they saved for their firm, Matt is not upset and they go to Josie's. The memory later pushes Matt to go back for Dex.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#5
adds.text: Years before, Wesley tells Fisk that Ray McCoy has refused his plea deal, suggests putting money into art, and brings Fisk to the gallery where he first sees Vanessa.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Wesley's boss, whom he steers into art and to Vanessa's gallery.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's right-hand man, who brings him to the gallery where he sees Vanessa.
adds.evidence: In The Grand Design (S2#5) flashbacks, Wesley informs Fisk that McCoy refused the plea deal, suggests art as a revenue source through a gallery, sends Cashman after McCoy, and is with Fisk at the Scene Contempo Gallery exhibition where Fisk notices Vanessa.

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
adds.text: Heather checks on Fisk after Vanessa's death, and he gives her Vanessa's second earring, knowing she took the first.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor Heather serves, who gives her Vanessa's earring.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's commissioner, who checks on him after Vanessa's death.
adds.evidence: In The Hateful Darkness (S2#7), Glenn visits Fisk's office to ask how he feels now his wife is gone; he says love was his prison and gives her Vanessa's second earring, knowing she stole one. (She also falsifies Duquesne's evaluation in S2#1 and testifies for the prosecution in S2#8.)

adds.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#7
adds.text: Matt comes out of hiding to join Kirsten as co-counsel at Karen's trial. As they leave court, the Anti-Vigilante Task Force attacks them, and Matt is shot.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Law partner and friend, who joins Kirsten to defend Karen.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Law partner and friend, who defends Karen with Matt.
adds.evidence: In The Hateful Darkness (S2#7), Murdock shows up at Page's trial as McDuffie's co-counsel; the AVTF attacks them in the parking lot, Cherry and Kim get McDuffie out and Murdock is shot. (Earlier, S2#3 Daredevil visits McDuffie for details of her trip to Red Hook.)

owner_calls.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2
owner_calls.question: Daredevil: Born Again S2#6 replays the night Karen shot Wesley (archive flashback of Daredevil S1#11; the wiki calls them nightmares about the killing). Is a replayed memory of a real event enough for a stage here?
options: Add enemy at Daredevil: Born Again S2#6: "Karen relives shooting Wesley dead, a memory that still haunts her." Cards: on Wesley's "The woman who shot Wesley dead, still haunted by it."; on Karen's "Fisk's right-hand man, whose killing still haunts Karen."
owner_calls.evidence: James Wesley appearances list 'DDBA206 (flashbacks)' nested under DD111; his biography says 'Years later, she still had frequent nightmares about her killing of Wesley' (ref DDBA206). Karen Page's appearances list the same. In S2#7 Glenn also taunts Karen with Wesley's death.
